green-with-hat-conversation-1.npc: I have a riddle for you.
A tree which is planted on Monday and doubles in size each day is fully grown on the following Sunday. On what day is it half grown?
Saturday. You big folk really aren't the quickest!

green-with-hat-conversation-2.npc: To be or not to be.

green-with-hat-conversation-2.player: Hey I know that. Where's it from?

green-with-hat-conversation-3.npc: My mum says: A friendly look, a kindly smile one good act, and life's worthwhile!

green-with-hat-conversation-4.npc: I wrote a few children's books.

green-with-hat-conversation-5.npc: The human mind is a tremendous thing.

green-with-hat-conversation-7.npc: Real generosity is doing something nice for someone who will never find it out.

green-with-hat-conversation-8.npc: But then it doesn't tend to rain much around here.

green-with-hat-conversation-9.npc: Hardy, ha ha! Hee, hee hee!
I'm a little tree gnome. That is me!

green-with-hat-conversation-10.npc: I have a riddle for you.
I am the beginning of eternity and the end of time and space. I am the beginning of every end and the end of every place. What am I?
I'm 'e'! Hee hee! Do you get it?

green-with-hat-conversation-11.npc: I worship Guthix, the god of balance.
He really does have exceptional co-ordination.

green-with-hat-conversation-12.npc: Not really, I just saw a man with a wooden leg.

green-with-hat-conversation-13.npc: I'm making wine out of raisins.
So I don't have to wait for it to age.

blue-conversation-1.npc: She does I tell you. She really loves me!

blue-conversation-2.npc: I just want something to happen!
Something, anything, I don't know what!

blue-conversation-3.npc: A little inaccuracy sometimes saves tons of explanation!

blue-conversation-4.npc: Hello. Why are you so tall?

blue-conversation-4.player: Um... I've always been this height.

blue-conversation-4.npc: Maybe you should eat more worms.

blue-conversation-6.npc: Guthix's angels fly so high as to be beyond our sight but they are always looking down upon us.

blue-conversation-7.npc: Hello, would you like a worm?

blue-conversation-7.text: The gnome gives you a worm

blue-conversation-7.npc: In the gnome village those who are needy receive what they need, and those who are able give what they can.

blue-conversation-8.npc: Dimensionality is a function of consciousness.
That's all you need to know.

blue-conversation-9.npc: Surely, if you're scared to die...

blue-conversation-10.npc: A warning traveller! The new world will rise from the underground!

blue-conversation-11.npc: Some advice traveller. We can walk, run, row or fly but never lose sight of the reason for the journey or miss the chance to see a rainbow on the way.

blue-conversation-12.npc: I'm always at peace with myself.

blue-conversation-13.text: The gnome appears to be singing.

blue-conversation-13.npc: I'm gonna sweep you off your feet.

green-conversation-1.npc: Hey big [man/woman], watch where you're standing.
I wouldn't want to make a mess of your shoes.

green-conversation-2.npc: Have you seen our big tree?

green-conversation-3.npc: Have you seen our big tree?

green-conversation-4.npc: You are the contained centre of an O.
While me, I'm much more. I am the pyramidic containment of an A.

green-conversation-5.npc: I'm trying to make a comeback!
It's hard when you haven't been anywhere.

green-conversation-6.npc: Aaaaarrggghh... humans! Run for your lives!

green-conversation-7.npc: Hello brave adventurer. A warrior like you should go a long way.
The further, the better! Hee hee!

green-conversation-8.npc: Es ataris eto meriz ip prit es gutus!
Es ataris eto meriz ip prit es gutus!

green-conversation-9.npc: Not great, it's just... well... people just don't seem to take me seriously!

green-conversation-11.npc: Why don't you make like a tree...

green-conversation-12.npc: Top of the morning to you.

green-conversation-13.npc: The only thing that is constant...
